subject: Post-call recap: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups, blended rates, new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>, Priya Iyer <priya.iy@acme-health.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Renewal + expansion pricing (volume step-ups, blended rates)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on pricing & qualification as you plan the 2027 rollout.

Call highlights:
- Renewal target: Oct 1 renewal for existing usage (clinical summarization).
- Expansion: plan to add two new routes over next 6–9 months - "patient-chat" and "clinical-summaries-extended" which will increase token volume and use a mix of models (efficient smaller models + occasional larger LLMs for long context tasks).
- Current baseline: you mentioned ~10M tokens/month today; forecast is a staged ramp to ~40M tokens/mo by Q4 2027 (rough).

Immediate asks for us to finalize an initial quote:
1) Can you confirm current monthly token baseline (total across routes)?
2) Do you have a target budget range for the renewal/expansion (e.g., $X per 1M tokens or an annual budget band)?
3) Any required latency SLOs per route (patient-chat vs. batch summarization)?

What we can do next (proposed):
- I will circulate a draft pricing estimate with step-up tiers and an example blended-rate calculation for mixed-model usage (attached once we align on volumes).
- Michael will scope any perf/latency implications of adding new routes.
- If procurement/finance are ready, Priya / your procurement contact can share any required PO/contract timing.

Proposed next call: Thu Jul 23, 10am PT - 30 min to review the estimate and lock on a target $/1M tokens.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: (will attach pricing estimate once volumes confirmed)

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Iyer <priya.iy@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal + expansion pricing (volume step-ups, blended rates)

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. Quick answers below so you can start the estimate:

1) Current baseline: ~10M tokens/month across clinical summarization (about 70%) and triage automation (30%).
2) Forecast: we expect a phased ramp - 20M/mo by Q1 2027, 30M/mo by Q2, ~40M/mo by Q4 assuming both new routes go live.
3) Budget: we don’t have a final target yet - leadership has given us a rough goal of keeping unit costs under $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens across the blended workload, but open to suggestions depending on quality tradeoffs.
4) Latency: patient-chat needs sub-500ms p95 for interactive flows; summarization can be batch (up to 5s ok).

One more ask: for the blended-rate calc, please show an example where 70% of tokens use the efficient 8-bit quantized model (lower $/1M) and 30% use a more capable model for longer-context tasks. Also include an option for committing to a 12-month reserved capacity (what discount levels we’d get at 3x / 5x / 10x current volume).

Priya (cc) will be the procurement lead - looping her in here for timing.

Samir
Head of Product, Acme Health
samir.shah@acme-health.com | +1 (617) 555-0189

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>, Priya Iyer <priya.iy@acme-health.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal + expansion pricing (volume step-ups, blended rates)

Thanks Samir - this is super helpful. I put together an initial pricing estimate based on the numbers you provided and three step-up tiers (monthly committed tokens). Attached: "acme-pricing-estimate-v3.xlsx" which contains the full math - below are the headline examples so you can see the blended $/1M tokens quickly.

Headline tiers (examples):
- Tier A (baseline commit = 10M/mo): $1,250 per 1M tokens
- Tier B (commit = 30M/mo): $1,050 per 1M tokens
- Tier C (commit = 60M/mo): $900 per 1M tokens

Blended example (70% efficient model @ Tier B pricing, 30% capable model at +45% premium):
- Efficient model unit = $1,050 per 1M
- Capable model unit = $1,523 per 1M (1,050 * 1.45)
- Blended unit = 0.7*1050 + 0.3*1523 = $1,144 per 1M tokens

Reserved capacity discounts (annual commit):
- 3x baseline: additional 6% off list (applied to blended),
- 5x baseline: additional 12% off list,
- 10x baseline: additional 20% off list + dedicated pool options and SLA credits

Given your leadership target of $900–$1,200 per 1M, the blended example at Tier B lands inside that band ($1,144), and Tier C with higher commit reaches the $900 goal. The spreadsheet includes a sensitivity table so we can tweak the % split and premium assumptions.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment: Michael will confirm perf/latency numbers and any cost delta for the patient-chat route.
2) We’ll finalize a commercial term (12-month vs 24-month) to show the specific discounting for your procurement team.
3) If acceptable, I’ll circulate a formal quote and a DocuSign link for signature.

Would Thu Jul 23 at 10am PT still work to walk through the spreadsheet?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: acme-pricing-estimate-v3.xlsx

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal + expansion pricing (volume step-ups, blended rates)

Samir / Marissa - quick technical note ahead of our call today.

Adding the "patient-chat" route with sub-500ms p95 requirements will impact the effective unit cost if we need to prioritize interactive latency (smaller batch windows, fewer batching opportunities). My preliminary estimate:
- If ~70% of patient-chat traffic is interactive at p95<500ms, expect a ~10–15% increase in unit cost for that route vs. background batch usage.
- The summarization route (batch, up to 5s) can be heavily batched and will keep unit costs lower.

I ran a quick perf/cost projection and attached a short PDF "model-routes-latency-breakdown.pdf" with the potential delta across three scenarios (aggressive batching / mixed / low-latency first).

Happy to review the PDF on the call and then run a more precise perf run against your sample workload once you share a small trace (anonymized).

—Michael
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

Attachments: model-routes-latency-breakdown.pdf

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme-health.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Renewal + expansion pricing (volume step-ups, blended rates)

Thanks all - that looks great and aligns with what we discussed. Thu 10am PT worked well to walk through the spreadsheet; the team is aligned on moving forward with a 12-month commit analysis first.

Next actions from Acme:
- Priya will review the spreadsheet and follow up on procurement timing.
- I will get you a small anonymized usage trace for Michael to run the perf numbers.

Marissa - please send the formal quote and DocuSign when you have the updated numbers (include both 12-month and 24-month commit options). If possible, highlight the blended $/1M scenarios and the point at which we reach ~$900 per 1M.

Priya, looping you to own procurement cadence.

Samir
